title: Costumbres y Tradiciones
welcome_lead: Customs and festivals enrich Experiences. From La Tomatina to Dia de Muertos, traditions span the Spanish-speaking world.
meta_desc: Spanish: customs, traditions, festivals across Spain and Latin America.
final_note: Tradition lives in language — name it and you honour it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Bunol, Spain — last Wednesday of August. Tomatoes thrown in mass food fight. Una celebracion unica en el mundo.
Mexico, 1-2 November. UNESCO heritage. Las familias honran a sus difuntos con ofrendas, calaveras y comida.
Use mientras que: Mientras en Espana se celebra La Tomatina, en Mexico se honra el Dia de Muertos.
